<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Docking Control Room 327''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター・ドッキング・コントロール・ルーム327</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、リザーブデッキの中から直接ドッキング・ベイを取り出して配備することができる。その後でリザーブデッキはシャッフルする。</span>

'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、なおかつここに能力値＞２の反乱軍が配備されているなら、フォース消耗は＋２される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Death-Star-Docking-Control-Room-327-SWCA-97583.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Docking Control Room 327.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control, you may take a docking bay directly from your Reserve Deck and deploy it. Then shuffle your Reserve Deck.

'''Light Side:''' If you control and a Rebel with ability > 2 is deployed here, Force drain +2.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
